answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ivory challenge every epoch. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest thread a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the oasis is shared, not multiplied. Seal 94114.
